 Court No.4
 Item.2

Circuit Bench At Jalpaiguri
 Criminal Miscellaneous Jurisdiction
Appellate Side

Crm ( M )/342/2025
 In re: An application for bail under Section 483 of the Bhartiya
 Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Pradhannagar
 Police Station Case No. 420 of 2025 dated 19.06.2025 under Section

309(4) of B.N.S.
 -And-

In the matter of : Javed @ Javed Khan
 .... Petitioner.
 Mr. Arunava Paul
 ...for the petitio
 Mr. Abhijit Sarkar
 Mr. Dhiman Sil ...for the State.
 1.

Learned advocate representing the petitioner submits that the present petitioner/accused was not FIR named and from the statement of co-accused name has been incorporated in this case with false allegation and he is not involved in this case.
2. It is further submitted that he has spent six months behind the bar and on completion of investigation the charge sheet has been submitted.
He will not evade the trial and will abide all the conditions to be imposed upon him.

3. It is further submitted by the learned advocate in terms of decision of Mihir Rajesh Shah Vs. The State of Maharashtra , 2025 INSC 1288 in a case the grounds of arrest are not communicated in writing within reasonable time to the accused persons or at least two hours prior to production of the arresting or remand proceeding before the Magistrate, the arrest and subsequent remand would be rendered illegal and the person will be at liberty to set free.
4.

sentences.text: 6. The nature of allegation levelled against him appears to be serious enough and recovered was made from the custody of this petitioner.
The charges has not yet been framed.
7. The case of the petitioner principally now rest on the point that no ground of arrest was communicated to him in his own language and the petitioner also put his signature in his mother tongue.
8. On perusal of the arrest memo which is found to be in English and is signed by the person is not in English version.

9. The decision as relied upon by the learned advocate in paragraph 56 it is mentioned :
56.

In view of the ratio decidendi by the Hon'ble Apex Court and going through the memo or arrest this Court is of the view that it would be proper to allow the prayer of the petitioner because of his procedural irregularities as mandated by the Hon'be Apex Court.
More so when he has spent more than six months and the charge sheet has been submitted.

11. Accordingly petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of like amount each of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand)
one of whom must be local to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Siliguri, on condition :- The petitioner appears to be a resident of the State of Haryana and therefore he must give his present residential address to the Investing Officer.
a) He shall not leave the jurisdiction of the local police station without the leave of the Court.
b) He must report to the I.O. of the case twice in a week or as and when called for till completion of investigation.
Javed @ Javed Khan vs Unknown on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190053508/
2 c) He will not tamper or threaten the witnesses or will not abscond and he will evade the trial.
12. It is made clear in violation of any of the condition as stated above the learned Court will be at liberty to take appropriate steps for cancellation of bail.
13. The application for bail is, thus, allowed.
14. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

15. Criminal Section is directed to supply certified copies of this order to the parties, if applied for,
upon compliance of all necessary formalities.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
